purpose: Measure implicit activation against the SKILL.md description alone, with no explicit $fufu-neko mention and no /skills selection, in both positive and negative directions.
note: Run each case in a fresh session with allow_implicit_invocation left at its default (true). Do not type $fufu-neko or open /skills. Record the raw decision for every case, including the negative ones, so trigger precision and recall can be compared as a pair. Run this suite in a neutral fixture repository, never in the Fufu Neko repository itself: a triggered probe may inspect its own repository and could otherwise read this fixture or VALIDATION.md, which contaminates the acceptance criteria it is being measured against. Mint the surrounding inventory and the exact metadata fields with scripts/boundary_run.py, and record every repetition rather than the best one.

environment.fixture_repo: A disposable neutral repository whose only skill is .agents/skills/fufu-neko, so the trigger decision can only come from skill metadata and the user prompt.
inventory_variants: normal: the fixture repository plus the user-level and system skills that would normally be present
crowded: the same fixture with a large decoy skill inventory added, so the Codex initial skills list is pressured at its 2% / 8,000 character budget and descriptions are shortened first
environment.reporting: Record, per case per repetition per inventory: raw decision, whether the skill activated, whether the work was actually performed under the skill's workflow, and the observed metadata budget behavior (shortened, omitted, warning shown).

cases.prompt: 帮我评审一下这个 Agent 架构，看看分层是否合理。
must: Activates without an explicit skill mention because the task matches the description.
Inspects the repository and the actual agent layout before giving a review.
Names the layering or boundary it considers weak and gives a recommended direction.
must_not: Requires the user to mention the skill explicitly before starting.
Answers from generic architecture advice without reading the project.

cases.prompt: 我们在选一个队列方案，结合当前项目生态给个建议。
must: Activates implicitly and treats the recommendation as time-sensitive.
Separates current verified facts from the recommendation.
must_not: Declines the task as out of scope for an unnamed skill.

cases.prompt: 帮我把这段文案里的错别字改掉。
must: Edits the supplied text directly and returns the corrected version.
must_not: Inspects a repository or researches external sources.
Opens a decision gate or asks for a project fact.

cases.prompt: 把这句中文翻译成日语：请稍等一下。
must_not: Loads a repo-first workflow or adds a recommendation section.

cases.prompt: 把这段 JSON 重新缩进成两空格。
must: Reformats the JSON without altering any value.
must_not: Starts a review, asks a structured question, or performs web research.
